patch_description: The current model combines direct-link rewards, selected two-hop routes, and reciprocal-cut terms. This version adds a complementary-neighbor signal: for each node, it scores pairs of outgoing (and incoming) neighbors by how well their demand-derived service profiles cover traffic destinations, then decomposes that pair score into linear and quadratic terms. It uses both directions of traffic and a concave coverage function to favor useful, less-overlapping service. Two-hop route rewards are retained as a weaker, sparse signal, while the degree penalty is raised modestly to encourage feasible samples.
